title: Educated: A Memoir
author: Tara Westover
summary: Tara Westover grows up in a survivalist family in rural Idaho with little formal schooling, then teaches herself enough to reach university and eventually Cambridge, at the price of her family ties.
readIf: you like memoirs about self-reinvention and the pull of family loyalty.
skipIf: you would struggle with descriptions of physical abuse and serious injuries.
